faqs.question: Is emergency and ambulance service available 24x7 at Geeta Hospital Mundra?
faqs.answer: Yes, Geeta Hospital operates a full 24x7 Emergency Room, ICU Ambulance service, In-house Pathology Laboratory, and In-house Pharmacy 365 days a year. Call our emergency hotline at +91 78743 81551 anytime.

faqs.question: Which insurance companies and TPAs provide cashless hospitalization at Geeta Hospital?
faqs.answer: Geeta Hospital provides cashless facilities for Adani Group, Jindal SAW, DP World (MICT), Tata Power, Airport Authority, TG Terminal, Inosource, and almost all major insurance companies and TPAs including Reliance General Insurance, HDFC ERGO, Paramount TPA, Medi Assist, Star Health, and ICICI Lombard.

faqs.question: How can I book an appointment with a doctor at Geeta Hospital?
faqs.answer: You can book directly online through our Kivihealth appointment portal (https://kivihealth.com/clinic/geeta-hospital), call us at +91 78743 81551, or walk in during regular OPD hours (10:00 AM - 1:30 PM & 5:00 PM - 8:00 PM).

faqs.question: Which visiting super-specialist doctors are available and what are their OPD schedules?
faqs.answer: We have visiting super-specialists in Cardiology (Dr. Jaydatt Tekani, 1st Thursday), Neurology (Dr. Naushad Ravjani, 1st & 3rd Thursday), Rheumatology (Dr. Yogesh Patel, 1st & 3rd Wednesday), Brain & Spine Surgery (Dr. Krushnakumar Virda, 2nd Saturday), ENT (Dr. Ankur Dhanani, 2nd & 4th Saturday), IVF & Infertility (Dr. Rajesh Punjabi & Dr. Shital Punjabi, 1st Saturday), Laparoscopic Surgery (Dr. Binal Trivedi, Saturday), and Ophthalmology/Cataract (Dr. Anvay & Smruti Gandhi, Sunday).

faqs.question: Does Geeta Hospital have intensive care for premature and sick newborn babies?
faqs.answer: Yes, we maintain a dedicated 5-bed Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) equipped with infant warmers, phototherapy, neonatal ventilators, high-flow nasal cannula (HHFNC), and portable X-ray led by experienced pediatricians and neonatologists.

faqs.question: Where is Geeta Hospital located in Mundra?
faqs.answer: Geeta Hospital is conveniently located at 3, Ambe Nagar, Near Gajanand Complex, Gundala Road, Baroi-Mundra, Kutch, Gujarat 370421. It is situated on a highway road-touch plot with ample parking space.
